ar.title: القنبيط بالباشامل

steps.n2: يوضع في الماء المغلي المضاف إليه الملح والكمون بحيث تكون الزهرة لأسفل والأعناق لأعلى حتى تنضج نوعا ما.
steps.n3: ترفع في مصفاة حتى تجف ثم تحمر في الزيت وترفع على مناديل ورقية.
steps.n4: يضرب البصل والطماطم والفلفل الأخضر والثوم مع الملح والفلفل في الخلاط، وتشوَح هذه الخلطة في إناء به زيت حتى الغليان.
steps.n5: نحضر بايركس أو صينية فرن ونضع فيه القنبيط المحمر والعصاج (اختياري)، ثم نخلطه بصلصة الخضار جيدا.
steps.n6: يغطى بالباشاميل وتوضع فوقه قطعة من الزبد وترش بالجبن، ويوضع في فرن متوسط الحرارة حتى النضج.

en.title: Qanbeet with Béchamel (Cauliflower Béchamel)

steps.n1: Cut the cauliflower and remove the thick stems.
steps.n2: Place it in boiling water seasoned with salt and cumin, ensuring the florets are facing down and the stems are facing up, until partially cooked.
steps.n3: Remove using a strainer to drain, then fry in oil until golden and set aside on paper towels.
steps.n4: Blend the onion, tomatoes, green pepper, and garlic with salt and pepper in a blender, then sauté this mixture in a pan with oil until it boils.
steps.n5: Prepare a Pyrex dish or baking tray and add the fried cauliflower and the minced meat mixture (optional), then mix well with the vegetable sauce.
steps.n6: Cover with béchamel sauce, top with a knob of butter and a sprinkle of cheese, and bake in a medium oven until cooked through.

legacySteps: Cut the cauliflower and remove the thick stems.
Place it in boiling water seasoned with salt and cumin, ensuring the florets are facing down and the stems are facing up, until partially cooked.
Remove using a strainer to drain, then fry in oil until golden and set aside on paper towels.
Blend the onion, tomatoes, green pepper, and garlic with salt and pepper in a blender, then sauté this mixture in a pan with oil until it boils.
Prepare a Pyrex dish or baking tray and add the fried cauliflower and the minced meat mixture (optional), then mix well with the vegetable sauce.
Cover with béchamel sauce, top with a knob of butter and a sprinkle of cheese, and bake in a medium oven until cooked through.
